title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje te rruga Mine Peza
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 tek rruga Mine Peza, prane prokurorise.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5-te te nje pallati ekzistues, siper eshte dhe nje kat tjeter.
Ka nje hapsire te bollshme, organizim perfekt, korridor shperndares ne hyrje, 2 dhoma gjumi te bollshme, ambient ndenje i madh, ballkon dhe 1 tualet.
Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug-perendim.
Shitet totalisht i mobiluar.
Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni!
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on Mine Peza street
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on Mine Peza street, near the prosecutor's office. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an existing building, there is another floor above. It has a spacious space, perfect organization, distribution corridor at the entrance, 2 spacious bedrooms, large living room, balcony and 1 bathroom. The orientation of the apartment is south-west. For sale fully furnished. For more information contact us!
